conditions: This API must be called in each app session before calling getConsentStatus().
effects: After this API is called, the getConsentStatus() API return value will be updated synchronously to hold the consent state from the previous app session, if one exists.
getConsentStatus() may be updated again to the up-to-date status after ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateSuccessListener is called.

conditions: The parameters for these values are required for this API to function properly.
The 'Activity' parameter represents the activity used to collect screen cut-outs.
The 'ConsentRequestParameters' parameter is used to set the request parameters.
The 'ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateSuccessListener' is used to handle the event when consent information update success.
The 'ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateFailureListener' is used to handle the event when consent information update fails.
effects: Collects consent information and updates user's consent status accordingly.

conditions: Once requestConsentInfoUpdate(Activity, ConsentRequestParameters, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateSuccessListener, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateFailureListener) is called, this method returns true when getConsentStatus() returns ConsentInformation.ConsentStatus.NOT_REQUIRED or ConsentInformation.ConsentStatus.OBTAINED.
effects: Returns true if the app has completed the necessary steps for gathering updated user consent

conditions: Returns ConsentInformation.ConsentStatus.UNKNOWN until requestConsentInfoUpdate(Activity, ConsentRequestParameters, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateSuccessListener, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateFailureListener) is called.

Returns ConsentInformation.PrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus.UNKNOWN until requestConsentInfoUpdate(Activity, ConsentRequestParameters, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateSuccessListener, ConsentInformation.OnConsentInfoUpdateFailureListener) is called.
effects: Returns the status indicating whether a privacy options button is required
